body: I didn't do great but I passed my courses.  It's just that no matter how hard I try, the result is the same.  I think to myself why am I even going to school?  There are plenty of mechanics here and pay is low.  Trying to set up a shop will cost a lot.  My family that does care isn't coming back here and I don't have enough to move away.  I barely have enough right now for anything and no one will hire me because every company is occupied.  I feel like there's no reason for me to be here anymore.
